f.pu: To regulate fishing activities within Iceland’s fisheries jurisdiction in order to protect vulnerable marine resources, manage stock sustainability, and control the use of fishing gear and effort in designated areas.
f.re: Fishing with all fishing gear is prohibited in the area where a water pipeline and an electric cable lie between the mainland and the Vestmannaeyjar Islands.
f.rn: 732/1997 Reglugerð um bann við veiðum milli lands og Vestmannaeyja (Regulation no. 732/1997)
